Backend: pytest test_phase47.py 7/7 PASS, test_phase46.py 6/6 PASS, test_phase46b.py 4/4 PASS (when each file runs in its own pytest session); new test_phase47_live.py (9 live tests against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) 9/9 PASS. No throwaway data created on live DB.
critical_code_review_comments: test_phase46*/47 share module-scoped fixtures that mutate server.db to a per-file TEST_DB; when all three files run in a single pytest session, later tests inherit the previously-set db and fail. This is a pre-existing test infra issue (not a Phase 47 regression). Suggest switching to lifespan deps or restoring the original server.db in fixture teardown so the files can run together.
server.py remains >11k lines — long-standing split candidate (noted in prior iterations).
FastAPI on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: None on live DB. Unit tests use throwaway DB lnmo_phase47_test which is dropped on setup/teardown. Live tests do not register parents or send reminders on real classes (Grade 8 reminder POST only asserts dedupe path and does not change quota; bulk slip POST on Grade 5 regenerates unused codes but no parent registration performed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 47 fully green. Reusable live suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase47_live.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, no state mutation on real data). CAVEAT: do not run test_phase46.py + test_phase46b.py + test_phase47.py in a single pytest invocation — they must be run file-by-file due to module-scoped server.db mutation (see critical_code_review_comments[0]).
